adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` and `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb) but that action only `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` and never reads params or persists anything (and `@embedding` is an `OpenStruct` in `fetch_embedding`). On the client, `admin-embedding` controller defines `saveChanges() { this.get('embedding').update({}); }`, but `embedding.hbs` never invokes `saveChanges` (only `addHost` / per-host save+delete via `embeddable-host` component). So the finding that this update path is currently dead/no-op is supported by the diff; it’s not a user-facing defect today because nothing calls it, but it is a real completeness/maintainability issue and could become a silent-no-save trap if settings are later added to the embedding resource.
